slides.heading: Return Values
slides.body: Return Values is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Return Values
slides.body: A return value sends a result back from a function. return lets a function produce a value that can be printed, stored, or used in another calculation.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A return value is like a vending machine giving back the snack after you press the button.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Define double(n) that returns n * 2, then print double(5).
slides.hint: Use return n * 2, then call it inside print().
